description.value: The Pub Bar & Grill at Park Place Lodge is Fernie's neighbourhood gathering spot explicitly marketed to mountain bikers, skiers, and fly-fishers looking to refuel after a day in the outdoors. The pub pours 16 beers on tap—including local Fernie Brewing Co. selections—and serves an extensive menu of Canadian pub classics alongside a British-inspired seasonal menu. A sunny outdoor patio with mountain views rounds out the experience at this lodge-based pub in the heart of the Elk Valley.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates the OSM phone number ((250) 423-6871) and address (742 Highway #3 = BC-3). Free WiFi is explicitly confirmed via 'enjoy free WiFi internet access' on the pub's own page. No mention of bike racks, bike parking, water refill, takeout availability, or washrooms appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: Minor name discrepancy: OSM records 'The Pub, Bar & Grill' (comma after 'Bar') while the website consistently renders it as 'The Pub Bar & Grill' (no comma).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A full-service pub and restaurant at a lodge in Fernie—a major cycling hub—explicitly catering to mountain bikers and outdoor adventurers, with confirmed free WiFi and an outdoor patio. A clear fit for the WWC directory pending on-site confirmation of bike parking.
